time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t=0
description: Top-down (near-nadir) drone view of an outdoor pickleball court (blue court, green surround, white lines, net across the middle, chain-link fence on the right). Portrait video. Two players (one at each end) play a point: near (bottom) player serves, far (top) player returns, near player hits a third shot; clip ends as that ball lands in the far court.

camera.type: overhead drone, essentially static; slow uniform zoom-in/descent of ~1.5% over the clip plus <=10 px drift
camera.per_frame_file: tracks/court_lines_per_frame.csv (court line centre positions each frame; use to correct for drift/zoom if needed)
camera.perspective_note: near-nadir view; far half (baseline->kitchen 676 px) vs near half (kitchen->baseline 687 px) at frame 0 differ by 1.6%, a tiny tilt. Treat as planar.

frame_timing_note: The file repeats a pattern every 4 frames: the image step INTO frames 4,8,12,...(i%4==0) is ~2x the other steps (ball moves e.g. 38,38,38,79 px). The 23.976 fps file was made from a ~29.97 fps source by dropping every 5th frame. Per-frame differences across those frames are doubled; tracks/ball.csv column after_dropped_frame=1 marks them. True source time of file frame i ~ (i + floor(i/4)) / 29.97 s.

objects.name: ball
objects.desc: yellow-green pickleball, colour-mask bbox ~8 x 6 px (median; 8-10 px along motion blur), equivalent diameter 6-8 px (median 6.8)

objects.name: ball_shadow
objects.desc: dark blob of the ball's cast shadow, falls to the -x side (sun from the right); offset from the ball grows with ball height, ~0 at bounces

objects.name: near_player
objects.desc: bottom player (serves): white shirt, black shorts, white shoes, paddle; starts behind near baseline at x~650,y~2350, moves up to x~930,y~2010

objects.name: far_player
objects.desc: top player (returns): white shirt, dark cap, light shorts, paddle; starts behind far baseline at x~950,y~240, runs forward to x~850-1020,y~590-680

objects.name: near_player_shadow
objects.desc: long cast shadow of near player extending to -x

objects.name: far_player_shadow
objects.desc: long cast shadow of far player extending to -x

objects.name: court
objects.desc: pickleball court, blue, white lines ~8-9 px wide

objects.name: net
objects.desc: net across the court centre; white top tape at y~1316, its dark shadow band y~1296-1311 (frame 0) extends left onto the grass to x~85; post at right x~1338

objects.name: fence
objects.desc: chain-link fence with dark posts/rail along the right side, vertical dark line x~1307-1316 (frame 0), from y~150 to y~2440; horizontal post shadows every ~290 px

objects.name: left_edge_objects
objects.desc: small whitish objects cut by the left image edge at y~1760 and y~1040 (unidentified, static)
